title: Singapore Malaysia Bali Honeymoon Package
highlights: Celebrate love across three diverse destinations with our Singapore Malaysia Bali honeymoon package, featuring stunning skylines, cultural richness, and peaceful coastal getaways.
Admire Singapore's iconic Merlion Statue, symbolising its transformation from a fishing village to a global metropolis, blending tradition and modernity.
Gaze up at Malaysia’s towering golden Lord Murugan statue, a majestic symbol of spirituality and devotion, standing guard over the sacred Batu Caves.
Feel the exhilaration of Bali’s Jungle Swing, soaring above lush rice terraces and tropical forests, capturing breathtaking views with every swing.
Explore Singapore’s Night Safari, the world’s first nocturnal park, home to over 1000 animals in their natural habitats, offering an unforgettable wildlife experience.
overview:
About the Destinations:
Singapore:
Singapore, a dynamic city-state, is known for its futuristic skyline, luxury shopping, and diverse culture. Ideal for couples seeking a blend of modernity and nature, Singapore offers romantic experiences like the Supertree Grove at Gardens by the Bay, a sunset cruise along Marina Bay, and visits to Sentosa Island for thrilling adventure parks. With the Singapore Malaysia Bali Honeymoon Package, couples can enjoy seamless travel. The Lion City is perfect for those who enjoy fine dining, iconic landmarks, and exploring vibrant neighbourhoods like Chinatown and Little India.
Malaysia:
Malaysia offers a rich cultural tapestry and stunning natural landscapes, ideal for adventurous couples. With bustling cities like Kuala Lumpur, where you can visit the Petronas Towers, and serene beaches in Langkawi, Malaysia has something for everyone. In addition, the Singapore Malaysia Bali honeymoon tour package often includes romantic destinations like the Cameron Highlands and Kota Kinabalu for nature lovers. Ideal for those who love a blend of cosmopolitan experiences and scenic beauty, Malaysia is a fantastic choice for a memorable honeymoon.
Bali:
Bali, Indonesia’s most popular island, is a dream destination for couples seeking romance. Known for its pristine beaches, lush jungles, and rich cultural heritage, it’s ideal for honeymooners looking to unwind. Whether you're lounging on Seminyak Beach, exploring Ubud’s rice terraces, or visiting ancient temples like Uluwatu, Bali offers endless romantic experiences. With Singapore Malaysia Bali packages for couples, you’ll enjoy seamless travel across the islands. Bali is perfect for couples who crave relaxation, spirituality, and stunning natural beauty.

know_before_you_go: The activities and tickets included in the package are non-refundable in case of cancellation.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Please do not litter and keep the destinations clean.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Please note that Singapore has a strict policy against littering in public areas. Heavy fines are in place for those found littering.
Malaysia is a multicultural country. Kindly respect local customs, such as removing shoes before entering homes or places of worship.
This Singapore Malaysia Bali honeymoon tour package is inclusive of visa assistance; however, the cost is not included in the package.
Kindly do not carry any chewing gum as it is banned in Singapore and defaulters will be penalised.
Please note that jaywalking is not allowed in Singapore, if caught, fines will be imposed.
Singapore and Malaysia have a tropical climate with high humidity and frequent rainfall throughout the year. Pack accordingly with lightweight, breathable clothing and rain gear.
While credit card payments are widely accepted in Singapore, it is recommended that you carry some cash for small purchases.
Smoking is not allowed until and unless you are in a designated smoking area.
The currency used in Malaysia is the Malaysian Ringgit (MYR). It is advisable to exchange currency at authorised outlets or use ATMs.
It is recommended that you drink bottled water in Malaysia only to avoid potential health risks.
It is advisable to travel to Malaysia after being vaccinated for Hepatitis A, Tetanus and Typhoid.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your shoulders and knees covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Images are for representation purpose only.
Please note that it is mandatory to purchase travel insurance when booking a Singapore Malaysia Bali honeymoon package. Travel insurance is not included in this package.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Night Safari Zoo
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore! Upon arrival at Changi International Airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. In the evening, experience the world-renowned Night Safari Zoo, the world’s first nocturnal wildlife park, home to over 1000 animals from 120 species. Hop on the guided tram to explore seven geographical zones, spotting creatures like leopards, civets, and Malayan tigers. After an unforgettable night, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: City Sightseeing Tour | Visit Marina Bay Sands SkyPark | Gardens By The Bay
days.desc: Begin your Singapore sightseeing at Merlion Park, home to the iconic 8.6-metre Merlion statue, symbolising the city’s maritime heritage. You can stroll across the Helix Bridge, a 280-metre pedestrian bridge with a unique DNA-inspired design, to reach Marina Bay Sands. From the 56th-floor observation deck, enjoy stunning panoramic views of the skyline. Finally, explore Gardens by the Bay, featuring 18 towering Supertrees, before returning to the hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Kuala Lumpur | Leisure Day
days.desc: After checking out of the hotel, you'll be transferred to Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia’s vibrant capital. Check in and enjoy your day at leisure. If time permits, visit the Illusion 3D Art Museum, featuring over 50 interactive art pieces that challenge perception and encourage creativity. Next, shop for handicrafts, local art, and souvenirs at Central Market. Head to Jalan Alor, known to offer a variety of local delicacies like ‘satay’ & ‘char kway teow’. Return to the hotel on your own.

days.title: Day Trip Genting Highlands & Batu Caves
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to explore Genting Highlands, a renowned hill resort famous for its vibrant casinos, shopping, and thrilling theme parks, including Genting SkyWorlds. After experiencing the high-energy atmosphere, head to the Batu Caves, a stunning limestone hill featuring a series of caves and cave temples. Ascend the 272 colourful steps to reach the main temple, where you'll be greeted by the towering 42.7-metre-high Lord Murugan statue. Later, return to the hotel.

days.title: Kuala Lumpur Sightseeing Tour | Petronas Twin Tower Tickets
days.desc: Today, visit Istana Negara, the King’s Palace, known for its 22 stunning domes followed by Masjid Negara, Malaysia’s National Mosque, which can accommodate 15,000 worshippers under its iconic star-shaped roof. Admire exquisite local craftsmanship like traditional batik and wood carvings at Handicraft Centre. In the evening, walk on the world's highest two-story bridge at levels 41 and 42 of Petronas Twin Towers Observation Deck for breathtaking views of the city before returning to the hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Kuta | Candlelight Dinner
days.desc: After checking out of your hotel, board your flight to Kuta. Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, you’ll be driven to the hotel, nestled in the lush landscapes of Bali. Check in and take some time to relax amidst the serene surroundings. In the evening, indulge in a romantic candlelight dinner featuring authentic Balinese cuisine, renowned for its rich flavours and fresh local ingredients. Later, enjoy an overnight stay at the hotel, surrounded by the tranquil beauty of Kuta.

days.title: South Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Begin your day by exploring South Bali, starting with Tanjung Benoa Beach, renowned for its thrilling water sports like parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat rides. In the evening, head to Uluwatu Temple, located at 70 metres above the Indian Ocean. This 11th-century Hindu temple is famous for its breathtaking sunsets and the Kecak fire dance performances, which depict tales from the Ramayana. Later, return to the hotel for a night stay.

days.title: Leisure Day | Balinese Spa
days.desc: Enjoy a romantic and leisurely day in Kuta, perfect for couples seeking both relaxation and memorable moments. Begin with a serene walk through Kuta Square, where you can explore charming boutiques and local crafts. As evening approaches, visit the bustling Kuta Night Market, a vibrant hub offering local delicacies like pisang goreng (fried banana) and bakso (meatball soup). This intimate day lets you savour Bali’s beauty and rich culture, ideal for romantic escapes.
